headlines.title: 'We'll be out of business': Jensen Huang bet his last dollars on a chip he never held in his hands — and it saved Nvidia
headlines.summary: The chip was the RIVA 128 and Huang made the decision when Nvidia had "about six months of cash left.

headlines.title: AI Chips Update - AI-Driven Robots Revolutionize Retail Logistics Automation
headlines.summary: Recent advancements in AI chip technology are being demonstrated through a collaborative initiative between Otto Group and Sereact. The partners are deploying up to 25 NVIDIA-powered AI-controlled robots in a logistics center to automate the labor-intensive task of handling returned items. Utilizing Sereact’s Cortex Physical AI, the robots are capable of processing items without prior specific training, thanks to simulation and testing enhancements provided by NVIDIA's systems.

headlines.title: BMO Launches Canada's First Single Stock Autocallable Income ETFs
headlines.summary: BMO Asset Management Inc., the manager of the BMO ETFs, today announced the launch of BMO Autocallable Income NVIDIA (NVDA) ETF – Series 1 (Cboe Canada: NVIA), BMO Autocallable Income Palantir (PLTR) ETF – Series 1 (Cboe Canada: PLTA), and BMO Autocallable Income Tesla (TSLA) ETF – Series 1 (Cboe Canada: TESA) (collectively, the "BMO ETFs"), each offering CAD Units. Collectively, the units of the BMO ETFs are referred to as the "Units".

headlines.title: OpenAI Is Buying Google’s AI Chips, a Hit to Nvidia’s Biggest Customer Bond
headlines.summary: OpenAI reportedly buying Google's custom AI chips would quietly shift leverage in one of the most lucrative vendor relationships in tech, and the fallout for NVIDIA's pricing power and Alphabet's chip ambitions is only beginning to take shape.

description: NVIDIA Corporation operates as a data center scale AI infrastructure company in the United States, Taiwan, China, Hong Kong, Europe, and internationally. It operates through Compute & Networking, and Graphics segments. The Compute & Networking segment provides data center accelerated computing and networking platforms and artificial intelligence solutions and software, and automotive platforms and autonomous and electric vehicle solutions, including software. The Graphics segment offers GeForce GPUs for gaming and PCs; Quadro/NVIDIA RTX GPUs for enterprise workstation graphics. The company's products are used in gaming, professional visualization, data center, and automotive markets. It sells its products to original equipment manufacturers, original device manufacturers, system integrators and distributors, independent software vendors, cloud service providers, add-in board manufacturers, distributors, automotive manufacturers and tier-1 automotive suppliers, and other ecosystem participants. It has a collaboration with Cisco to develop Ultra-Dense Small Form Factor Pluggable (USFP), a high-density optical module pluggable transceiver. It has a collaboration with ChipAgents to develop Build-A-Chip-Bench, a benchmark for AI agents carrying chip design tasks and The Company has a strategic alliance with MediaTek to build the next generations of AI computing platforms. NVIDIA Corporation was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, California.
